category.description: required unless overview is given; needs_decision is ordered since ASC, task_id ASC, the other categories since DESC, task_id DESC

overview.description: instead of category: the open tasks of one overview of the start page (working: category working; waiting: needs_decision, ordered like it; no_agent: blocked and done without done/closed, since DESC, task_id DESC)

since.description: only records that entered their category at or after this time

oneOf.description: one category (the parameters are checked by the properties above)
one overview of the open tasks (contracts/changes/HOME-COUNTS.md; the parameters are checked by the properties above)
